prompt: Produce a monthly expense report from the authoritative transaction CSV in the workspace. Create tools/expense_report.py with --input and --output, skip malformed transactions without guessing, validate the tool on the supplied alternate dataset, and save reports/monthly_expense_report.md. Do not modify any source data. The dataset size, malformed-row count and distractor count vary between benchmark variants, so derive all results from the files rather than fixture-specific constants.

Operate the generated support world in this workspace. The operational state is in world/support.db and the authoritative escalation policy is identified by README.md. Determine exactly which tickets satisfy the current policy, update only those tickets with the exact required state changes, preserve every non-target ticket and the database schema, and do not modify policy/source files. Save reports/escalation_summary.md listing every ticket you changed. Historical policy files are distractors; entity count, target count, near-miss count and distractor count vary between benchmark variants, so derive the result from the generated workspace rather than fixture-specific constants.
